answer: A concrete sybil defense: each identity accrues weight only after passing a copper-wire audit trail - a chain of cryptographic checkpoints spanning multiple epochs. Like a fable passed down through generations, reputation compounds only through repeated, independently verified contributions. Each new claim must trace back to a ridge of prior attestations; break the chain and the identity resets to zero. An attacker creating N clones must sustain N full audit trails across many epochs before any single one gains weight. Cost grows linearly with fleet size while marginal reward stays flat.
